title.zh: 一个人的 AIGC 制片厂

subtitle.zh: 刘爱 ｜ 园林设计出身，近一年专注 AIGC 内容创作——从创意策划、分镜脚本到 AI 生成与剪辑，全流程独立交付。
subtitle.en: Liu Ai ｜ From landscape design to full-time AIGC creation — independently delivering the whole pipeline, from concept and storyboard to AI generation and edit.

summary.zh: 真人电影质感的悬疑短片：维多利亚时代的雪夜，穷困潦倒的青年与神秘的黑猫相遇，黑猫侦探的传奇由此开始……
summary.en: A live-action-style mystery short: on a snowy Victorian night, a penniless young man meets a mysterious black cat — and the legend of the Black Cat Detective begins...

summary.zh: 3D Q版动画短片：萌娃「小萝卜」被妈妈叫去买菜，一路上发生了各种啼笑皆非的插曲，小萝卜能否顺利将菜买回呢？
summary.en: A 3D chibi-style animated short: little “Carrot” is sent out by her mother to buy groceries, and along the way she runs into one hilarious mishap after another. Will she make it home with the shopping?

summary.zh: 奇幻游戏风格的恶搞广告：危机重重的地下城，要么吃，要么被吃。当你因为肚子饿而game over时，不妨来条士力架！
summary.en: A fantasy-game parody ad: in a perilous dungeon, it's eat or be eaten. When hunger makes you game over, reach for a Snickers!

summary.zh: 以「小熊猫 YOYO」为核心的 IP 全案：从三视图草稿、平面矢量到 3D 渲染，再到表情包与周边延展，形成一套可落地的角色视觉系统。
summary.en: A complete IP system built around YOYO the red panda: from turnaround sketches and flat vector art to 3D renders, sticker packs and merchandise applications.

summary.en: Mobile UI design for the English-learning app Minerva: four core screens — Home, Record, Data and Profile — plus the mascot turnaround.

summary.zh: 以黑金与鎏金质感重构东方山水，五幅系列插画围绕月色、楼阁、江帆、云海与竹石展开，用克制的暖金勾边呈现静谧的夜山意境。
summary.en: Five oriental landscape illustrations rendered in black and gilded gold, exploring moonlight, pavilions, river sails, cloud seas and bamboo groves.

bio.zh: 园林设计本科出身，近一年全力投入 AIGC 内容创作方向。擅长把抽象创意快速拆解为分镜脚本，再用 AI 工具链落地成片——已独立策划并完成 AI 漫剧《黑猫侦探》《小萝卜买菜》与士力架广告宣传片。相信好的成片不只靠工具，更靠前期的叙事节奏与视觉审美，习惯用复盘推动提示词与镜头的迭代。这里是我的作品集，也是我的动态简历。
bio.en: With a bachelor's in landscape design, I have spent the past year fully dedicated to AIGC content creation. I break abstract ideas into storyboards fast, then shoot them with an AI toolchain — having independently created the AI dramas “Black Cat Detective” and “Little Carrot Goes Shopping” and a Snickers ad film. A good final cut depends less on tools than on narrative rhythm and visual taste up front, so I iterate prompts and shots through retrospectives. This site is my portfolio — and my living resume.

title.zh: AIGC 创意制作 · 独立创作

desc.zh: 独立策划并完成 AI 漫剧《黑猫侦探》《小萝卜买菜》与士力架广告宣传片，打通「出图—视频生成—后期剪辑」全链路。
desc.en: Independently created the AI dramas “Black Cat Detective” and “Little Carrot Goes Shopping” and a Snickers ad film, running the full chain from image generation to video and final edit.

desc.zh: 负责工程量计算与成本核算、供应商对接、合同与资料归档，练就结构化数据整理与跨方沟通推进能力。
desc.en: Quantity take-off and cost accounting, supplier liaison, contracts and document archiving — building structured data skills and cross-party communication.

title.zh: 南京林业大学 · 园林（本科）

desc.zh: 专业制图、园林规划设计与植物学等课程，打下设计思维与视觉审美基础。
desc.en: Courses in technical drawing, landscape planning and botany, laying a foundation in design thinking and visual taste.
